title: R for Data Science
tagline: Transform data into insights -- Master statistical computing and visualization with R for impactful data analysis.
overview: This comprehensive course introduces you to R programming specifically for data science applications. You'll learn how to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data using R's powerful ecosystem of packages.

From basic statistics to advanced machine learning, the course covers everything needed to become proficient in data analysis. With real-world datasets and case studies, you'll gain practical experience solving actual business and research problems.
learningOutcomes: Master R programming fundamentals and RStudio environment
Perform data manipulation using dplyr and tidyr packages
Conduct statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
Build predictive models using machine learning algorithms
Work with time series data and forecasting
Document analysis using R Markdown for reproducible research

curriculum.title: Advanced Topics

targetAudience.title: Data Professionals

Familiarity with data concepts is helpful
Computer with R and RStudio installed
